**

Welcome to my Almhof in Tirol

** **

**Discover the authentic charm of an **Almhof** deep in the heart of **Tirol**—where tradition meets breathtaking Alpine scenery. Our rustic farmhouse, nestled among rolling meadows and towering peaks, invites you to slow down, breathe in the crisp mountain air, and reconnect with nature’s simplicity. **

**Wake up to the gentle sounds of cowbells and the scent of fresh hay. Enjoy homemade **Kaiserschmarrn**, creamy **Käsekrainer**, and hearty **Tiroler Gröstl**, all crafted with local ingredients straight from our farm. Sip on **Apfelstrudel** with a glass of crisp **Tiroler Apfelsaft**, or warm your hands around a steaming mug of **Kaffee mit Schlag**. **

**Explore the surrounding **Almen** on foot or by bike, or simply relax on our sun-drenched terrace with a book and a view of the **Zillertal** or **Ötztal** valleys. In the evenings, gather around the crackling fireplace for stories of **Tiroler** folklore—or just the soothing silence of the mountains. **

**Whether you’re seeking adventure, peace, or a taste of **Tiroler** hospitality, our **Almhof** is your gateway to a slower, richer way of life. Come as a guest, leave as family. **

** **Book your stay** | **Find us** | **Contact** --- **

Why stay with us?

** **
    ** **
  • **Genuine **Tiroler** farmhouse experience—no mass tourism, just pure Alpine life. **
  • **Fresh, organic meals made with love (and our own milk, cheese, and honey!). **
  • **Hiking trails, mountain lakes, and hidden gems right at your doorstep. **
  • **Cozy rooms with wooden beams, down duvets, and views of the **Karwendel** or **Nordkette**. **
  • **Stargazing like never before—our skies are so clear, you’ll see the **Milchstraße** (Milky Way) in all its glory. **
** **

Nearby Highlights

** **

**Just a short drive away, you’ll find: - The vibrant city of **Innsbruck**, with its **Goldenes Dachl** and **Nordkettenbahn**. - The fairy-tale villages of **Swovoboda** and **Mayrhofen**, gateway to the **Zillertal**. - The legendary **Achensee**, perfect for swimming, sailing, or a lakeside **Jausen**. - The historic **Burg Tratzberg**, where knights once roamed. - The **Tiroler Freilichtmuseum** in **Ehrenberg**, a living museum of **Tiroler** heritage. **

**No matter the season—whether it’s the golden hues of autumn, the snowy wonder of winter, or the blooming meadows of summer—your **Almhof** in **Tirol** awaits. **Willkommen in der Heimat!** (Welcome home!) --- **

Seasonal Delights

** **

** **Spring:** Fresh **Speckknödel**, **Radieschen** from the garden, and the first **Almhütten** opening their doors. **Summer:** Chilled **Zillertaler Bier**, **Obazda** with pretzels, and **Kuchen** by the lake. **Autumn:** **Marillenknödel**, **Kürbiscremesuppe**, and the crisp air of the **Almwiesen**. **Winter:** **Kaiserschmarrn** with **Apfelmus**, **Glühwein** by the fire, and the magic of a **Tiroler** Christmas. --- **

Testimonials
